skills.name: olko-factory-workflow-yaml
skills.description: Rules for the Software Factory workflow YAML in factory/workflows: how an Olko agent's steps map to phase groups, nodes, edges and conditions, which engine operations exist, how a workflow names its sources, and how to validate it. Use when you write, update or verify a factory workflow from an Olko agent or skill. Triggers: 'factory workflow', 'map agent to yaml', 'update factory yaml', 'verify factory workflow', 'olko-factory-workflow-yaml'.
